svg.title: The blank epilogue sits beside completed chapter packets
svg.desc: Keep the epilogue blank beside completed chapter packets and audit materials. Completion is a manuscript state, not the end of incoming evidence. Keep the recurring home window and shelves distinct from institutional review settings; this domestic interior remains reconstructed.
